flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4104 then book the free first visit class for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.

remark: click: Clicking Skip newsletter signup button
click: Closing the cookie notice using the Close button
click: Clicking Book free first visit button
click: Clicking the Free first visit class card
wait: queued plan (5 steps): type "Name"; type "Email"; select "Arrival time"; click "
click: Click "I accept the climbing waiver."
analyze: the reference code is stored as {{ref}}
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked the free first-visit class for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for November 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM.
Accepted the waiver to complete the booking.
The booking was confirmed, with reference code PL-7302.
